questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. C is the son of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: C is correct. A = father of B; B = sister of C (so B and C have same parents); C = son of D. Since A is father of B and B is sister of C, A is also father of C. D is parent of C (C is D's son). Therefore A and D are co-parents of C (and B). A=father → A is male; D must be the mother. A is D's husband.

questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Ravi says, 'This man's son is my son's father.' Who is the man in the photograph to Ravi?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'My son's father' = Ravi (because Ravi is the father of his own son). So the statement becomes: 'This man's son IS Ravi.' → This man is the father of Ravi → The man in the photo is Ravi's father. Strategy: always start from the end phrase and work backwards.

questions.stem: P is the brother of Q. R is the mother of Q. S is the father of P. T is the sister of P. How is R related to T?
questions.explanation: B is correct. P, Q, and T are siblings (P = brother of Q; T = sister of P → T is also sister of Q). R = mother of Q = mother of P = mother of T. S = father of P = father of Q = father of T. R is T's mother.

questions.stem: Introducing a woman, a man says, 'She is the mother of the only daughter of my son.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: A is correct. 'My son' = the man's son. 'The only daughter of my son' = the man's granddaughter. The woman is 'the mother of' that granddaughter. The granddaughter's mother = the man's son's wife = daughter-in-law. The woman is the man's daughter-in-law.

questions.stem: A girl points to a boy and says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my grandmother.' How is the boy related to the girl?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'My grandmother' = the girl's grandmother. 'The only daughter of my grandmother' = the girl's mother (since she has only one daughter). The boy's mother = the girl's mother → the boy and the girl have the same mother → the boy is the girl's brother.

questions.stem: M is the son of N. N is the daughter of O. O is the husband of P. How is M related to P?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Chain: M is son of N → N is daughter of O → O is husband of P → P is wife of O → P is mother of N → P is grandmother of M → M is grandson of P.

questions.stem: Rahul says to Priya, 'Your father's only son's wife is my aunt.' How is Priya related to Rahul?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Step 1: 'Priya's father's only son' = Priya's brother (only son of her father). Step 2: 'Priya's brother's wife' = Rahul's aunt. Step 3: Priya is the sister of Rahul's aunt's husband. Step 4: The sister of one's uncle (aunt's husband) = another aunt. Therefore Priya is Rahul's aunt → Rahul is Priya's nephew.

questions.stem: In a family, there are 6 members: A, B, C, D, E, F. A and B are a married couple. C is the son of A. D is the sister of C. E is the father of A. F is the mother of B. How many female members are in the family?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A = male (married couple → A is husband, B is wife); B = female; C = male (son of A); D = female (sister of C); E = male (father of A); F = female (mother of B). Female members: B, D, F = 3.

questions.stem: Looking at a portrait, Sunita says, 'He has no brother, and his father is my father's only son.' Who is in the portrait?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'My father's only son' = Sunita's father (Sunita's father is the only son, i.e., has no siblings). So the portrait person's father = Sunita's father. The portrait person is the son of Sunita's father = Sunita's brother? But 'he has no brother.' If Sunita is female, her brother could have only sisters. However, the standard exam interpretation: 'my father's only son' = Sunita's father himself (only son = no other brothers) → portrait person's father = Sunita's father → portrait person is Sunita's son (child of Sunita, whose father is Sunita's father's son = Sunita's husband). This is the standard answer.

questions.stem: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Chain: A = sister of B (same generation); B's mother = C; C's father = D. So D is the grandfather of B (and A). A is D's granddaughter. (E is D's mother — one more generation above, not needed for this question.)
